self_oscillation.method: Every startup sample through frame2047 and matching observed startup state; entire trace finite, exact width/RNG; first absolute threshold crossing from frame zero. Final-half RMS, peak, interpolated rising-crossing frequency compare independently per output. No alignment or hidden warmup; no pointwise phase-equivalence claim after frame2047. Both implementations must cross the threshold and contain at least ten late crossings.

scope: Stable-driven cases use first declared seed, both recorded initial previous-input values, all rates. Autonomous self-oscillation uses both seeds, zero previous input, all rates. All integrator states start at zero; harness explicitly assigns all16 previous inputs before processing, then seeds genuine SDK RNG and production Rust RNG with one documented discard. No upstream undefined cold-start equivalence claim.
limitations: Actual compiled Core and pinned unchanged C++ class; no reference DSP replacement or tolerance fitting.
Module-local Rust RNG deliberately differs from Rack's shared process-global stream; comparisons control the stream explicitly.
Finite fixture domain only; no device, native-window, physical hardware or universal Rack parity claim.
